zh-CN.title: 语音录制降噪
items: 聊天、广场发言和管理员广播录音统一启用回声消除、环境降噪与自动增益
支持的设备会进一步过滤低频杂音与高频嘶声并平衡音量，不支持时自动安全回退

en.title: Cleaner voice recordings
items: Chat, Square, and admin broadcast recordings now share echo cancellation, noise suppression, and automatic gain control
Supported devices also filter low-frequency rumble and high-frequency hiss while balancing volume, with a safe automatic fallback
